gen-gf-paprika-gf-bree-serif: Commanding from the first word, Paprika spreads its capital-sized lowercase wide, while Bree Serif, a classic serif, comes in refined and oversized. Give the heading more size than the text.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-quando: Quando spreads sparse, wide letter spacing and a tall middle zone through every word, giving a bookish, traditional text serif. Paprika's commanding heading above it keeps the page lively.
gen-gf-phudu-author: Author brings a refined serif voice, with a slight swell on the bowls and a dignified manner. Phudu's heading curves stay thin-free, so Author can be sized a touch larger to carry the page.
gen-gf-phudu-cabin: Bold, distinctive Phudu draws its curves with a plain ballpoint line and open terminals. Cabin follows, warm and clean, its bent-tubing sans letterforms feeling like a close cousin to that pen-like heading.
gen-gf-phudu-dm-sans: Phudu's tubular, wire-like letterforms are the first thing you notice, bold and open at every curve. And DM Sans, approachable and friendly with wide-set terminals on s, quietly carries the rest.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-aleo: Aleo reads dignified and classic, its counters letting the eye slip in and out. Phudu, drawn like a fixed-width nib, supplies the bold, distinctive heading while Aleo, a classic serif, handles the text.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-arvo: Traditional in temperament, Arvo keeps its curves from ever closing up, which gives paragraphs a dignified, open texture. Phudu does the loud work of announcing; Arvo does the patient work of carrying.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-biorhyme-expanded: BioRhyme Expanded reads refined and bookish, with wide gaps that let each letter stand alone and an open e you can see through. Phudu's bold display letters handle the shouting, and this serif keeps a long page unhurried.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-biz-udmincho: BIZ UDMincho brings a bookish, traditional text serif with shallow terminal curls and wide gaps between letters. And Phudu's solid, unshifting line weight sits above it as the bold, distinctive voice.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-copse: Phudu draws every letter with a flat, unvarying line weight and generous openings on each curve, which makes it bold and distinctive. It earns its keep big and short, above Copse.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-cutive: Phudu is bold and distinctive, a display face whose steel-cable outline never shifts from thick to thin in any letter. And Cutive follows with wide-tracked, literary serif text, best given room.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-david-libre: David Libre reads dignified and refined, its terminals hanging open so each word feels unhurried beside Phudu's uninterrupted line width. Bold display up top, a settled text serif below.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-enriqueta: Literary and dignified, Enriqueta's chalky curves stop well before closing. Phudu's stroke weight never varies, so its bold display letters sit above that soft text serif like a poster over a paperback.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-fenix: Fenix writes in a classic, editorial serif whose curves stop before turning inward. Phudu, bold and drawn like a ballpoint line, sits beside it feeling brash next to Fenix's bookish manners.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-gowun-batang: Gowun Batang is a refined, literary serif with terminals cut back. Beside Phudu's loud, ballpoint-plain strokes it reads like a quiet voice after a shout, and the two share the page without crowding.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-habibi: Strokes as plain as a ballpoint line give Phudu its bold, distinctive look. And Habibi, a traditional classic serif with a clear channel into each round letter, supplies the editorial counterweight.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-inika: Distinctive in its ballpoint-plain line, Phudu leaves generous openings on every curve. But Inika, a classic serif with a see-through gap in each s, brings a traditional, settled voice that lets the heading be loud.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-kay-pho-du: Generous openings on every curve, drawn in a plain ballpoint line, mark Phudu as bold. Kay Pho Du is a traditional serif whose counters breathe like a hollow reed, so paragraphs of it should move along smoothly.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-labrada: Labrada reads dignified and bookish, a classic serif with wide openings on its small letters. And Phudu, constant in stroke width and bold, earns its keep big and short.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-laila: Bold, with a ballpoint's plain line, Phudu leaves generous openings on every curve. Laila, a traditional serif with space between curve ends and stem, takes the supporting part so the heading can lead.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-montaga: Bold curves with generous openings, all in one pressure-free line, make Phudu hard to miss. Montaga, a classic serif with pen-lifted curves left unfinished, should read like stitched thread across a paragraph.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-new-tegomin: New Tegomin reads dignified and traditional, a classic serif whose c looks like a wide-open ring. Whole paragraphs of it settle in easily, well away from Phudu's blunt display.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-rhodium-libre: Phudu sets a blunt, pressure-free line, like a ballpoint dragged through a heavy display headline. And Rhodium Libre underneath is a serif with brush-lifted ends, editorial and traditional.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-sanchez: Sanchez, a dignified text serif, carries the reading with a c opened like calipers. While Phudu is happiest shouting in bold, ballpoint-plain strokes, Sanchez is happiest being read.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-yuji-boku: Dignified and editorial, Yuji Boku keeps each stroke like a drawn cable. Phudu does the bold, round-tipped shouting at display size, while the serif body does the patient, wide-open reading.
gen-gf-phudu-nunito-sans: Phudu looks cut from strips of equal width, bold and blunt as a display face. But Nunito Sans softens everything below, with open-mouthed curves in its small letters.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-author: Author brings a refined serif, its bowls swelling slightly beyond the hairlines. And Pixelify Sans stays bold and steady, never thinning, which makes the two feel pleasantly mismatched.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-cabin: Warm and sturdy, Cabin looks like bent tubing with open terminals. Cabin would feel oversized if blown up large, and Pixelify Sans would feel cramped if shrunk down.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-dm-sans: Pixelify Sans builds its display lines from one monoline stroke, bold and expressive. And DM Sans follows in a friendly sans, its wide-set s terminals keeping things approachable.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-fs-paquito: Bold letters from Pixelify Sans set the tone, every stroke held to an unvarying weight. But Paquito, a confident serif with capitals barely taller than its lowercase, keeps paragraphs approachable as they pile up.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-aleo: Rod-stock stiff and loud: Pixelify Sans draws horizontals and verticals at identical thickness, a bold, expressive heading. Aleo, a dignified serif with counters the eye slips through, adds classic footing.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-almendra-sc: Unvarying line weight defines Pixelify Sans, so no word ever mixes bold-looking and light-looking strokes. And Almendra SC, a classic serif with mouths left open, brings dignified authority underneath.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-antic-slab: Every stroke of Pixelify Sans holds to an unvarying weight, loud and expressive. And Antic Slab, a classic serif with round bowls and wide, barely curled s, gives it dignified editorial company.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-arvo: Pixelify Sans is bold and expressive, with no hairlines and no swells anywhere in its letters. Arvo, a traditional text serif, adds the pair's defining trait: curves that refuse to close.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-belgrano: A rope-like consistency runs through every stem, bowl and tail of Pixelify Sans. Belgrano, a traditional text serif, is at its finest in open-mouthed curves that stay clear, far from the heading's bold swagger.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-biorhyme-expande: BioRhyme Expanded reads refined and bookish, each word breaking into single letters. Pixelify Sans, bold and expressive at an unvarying line weight, handles the heading while this serif's open e gives the text room.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-cutive: Pixelify Sans is bold, expressive, and stout as a drawn pipe cleaner. It grabs attention in a heading, while Cutive, a refined, literary serif with wide tracking, is better at running text.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-david-libre: Pixelify Sans hums with a flat gray constancy of line weight, made for bold, expressive headings. But David Libre, a dignified text serif whose terminals hang open, does the refined reading work.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-enriqueta: Enriqueta is a classic serif with chalky curves that stop well short of closing, which gives it a dignified, literary hush. Pixelify Sans sits over it, blocky and unvarying in line weight.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-gentium-plus: Gentium Plus is a refined text serif, each c opening like the wide mouth of a pitcher. Pixelify Sans brings its bold, bent-paperclip strokes, and that sharp gap in character is what makes the pairing memorable.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-inika: Inika reads as a traditional serif, with a gap you can see through in each s. But Pixelify Sans brings the opposite rhythm up top, its bars identical in thickness across the whole line.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-labrada: Pixelify Sans holds one constant pen width throughout, bold and blocky and expressive. Labrada, a dignified serif with wide openings on small letters, would feel bookish and unhurried over a long stretch of text.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-laila: Blocky, bold, and unbending, Pixelify Sans ends each terminal at the width it began. Laila, a classic serif with generous space between curve ends and the stem, would feel cramped if it were set large.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-montaga: Bookish and editorial, Montaga is a text serif whose pen-lifted curves leave loops unfinished, like thread stitched along a path. Pixelify Sans stays blocky and bold above it, and a long read would feel light.
